# Where to Watch The Pursuit of Happyness


by Angel | September 30, 2026


What would you do if you had almost nothing left—but still had a child counting on you?


*The Pursuit of Happyness* tells the true story of Chris Gardner, a struggling salesman who finds himself homeless while raising his young son. When he earns an unpaid internship at a prestigious stock brokerage firm, Chris sees a chance to build a better future. But getting there means enduring hardship, uncertainty, and sacrifices most people could never imagine.


[Watch The Pursuit of Happyness on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/pursuit-of-happyness)


### **A Father Trying to Build a Better Life**


Chris Gardner is talented, ambitious, and determined to make something of himself. But talent doesn’t always translate into opportunity.


As a struggling salesman, Chris has trouble making ends meet. Then things get even harder. He and his five-year-old son are evicted from their San Francisco apartment, leaving them with nowhere to go.


But Chris refuses to let his circumstances determine his son’s future.


When he lands an internship at a prestigious stock brokerage firm, it gives him a possible path forward. There’s just one problem: the internship is unpaid, and Chris and his son still need somewhere to sleep.


The opportunity may be the break Chris has been looking for, but reaching the other side will require everything he has.


### **Life Between Hope and Hardship**


*The Pursuit of Happyness* doesn’t skip over the difficult parts of Chris’ journey.


He and his son move between shelters while Chris works to succeed in his internship. He has to compete against other aspiring brokers while trying to provide for his child, manage the practical realities of homelessness, and hold onto the belief that his circumstances can change.


The result is a story that finds hope without pretending the road there is easy.


One Angel Guild member described the film as “a great story of determination and perseverance.” Another called it a “highly motivational film about resilience, hope, and never giving up.”


Those themes are woven into nearly every part of Chris’ journey.


### **The Bond Between a Father and Son**


At the heart of the story is Chris’ relationship with his son. Everything he does is connected to one goal: giving his child a better life.


Even during some of the hardest moments, Chris tries to protect his son from the full weight of what they’re experiencing. The two share small moments of joy and connection alongside the uncertainty, creating a story that is as much about fatherhood as it is about career success.


One viewer described the film as a powerful story about “the bond of a child and parent,” while another praised it as a refreshing film that presents a father in a positive light.


Chris isn’t chasing success simply for himself. He’s trying to create a future for the two of them.


### **Based on a True Story**


What makes Chris Gardner’s journey especially powerful is that it really happened.


The film is based on Gardner’s life and his path from homelessness to a career in finance. That real-world foundation gives the story a different kind of weight. The hardships aren’t simply obstacles written for a movie—they reflect experiences Gardner actually faced.


That’s part of why audiences continue to connect with the film years after its original release.


One viewer who first saw the movie as a high school student wrote that it took another decade to fully understand Gardner’s story. Another called it a film that “transcends time, nationality, and race.”


### **Watch** ***The Pursuit of Happyness*** **on Angel**


Starring Will Smith and based on the true story of Chris Gardner, *The Pursuit of Happyness* follows a father who faces homelessness and extraordinary hardship while fighting to build a better future for himself and his son.


It’s a story of perseverance, fatherhood, sacrifice, and hope—and a reminder that sometimes the only way forward is to keep moving.
